subject: maths
question: Consider a right trapezoidal plot. Its parallel boundaries are 60 meters and 100 meters. The perpendicular height measures 40 meters. What is the total area of this plot??
solution:
**Given:**

Length of one parallel boundary = 60 meters

Length of the other parallel boundary = 100 meters

Perpendicular height = 40 meters

**Formula Used:**

Area of a trapezoid = (1/2) × (Sum of parallel sides) × Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = (1/2) × (60 + 100) × 40

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 160 × 40

⇒ Area = 80 × 40

⇒ Area = 3200 square meters

**∴ The correct answer is 3200 square meters.**
